title: Listening Drill — Book fair relocation
description: Public announcement. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Book fair relocation
sections.transcript:
ORGANISER: A quick update about the weekend book fair. Some of you have printed the original programme, so please take a moment to change your notes. The most important change concerns the venue.

ORGANISER: For now, go to the side gate. If that route is closed when you arrive, use the river path instead. It takes a few minutes longer, so allow enough time.

ORGANISER: Questions should go to Kim rather than the general enquiries desk. Before you leave, check the stall list on the noticeboard. We will post a further update only if another part of the plan changes.
